Patient profile for RES-Q stroke registry submissions. The registry patient is intentionally pseudonymized: the profile requires a stable registry identifier and represents sex/gender using a SNOMED CT coded extension because the source ETL does not populate Patient.gender. Age is represented as an Observation in the registry model rather than as a Patient extension.

Condition profile for the index stroke diagnosis. It captures stroke type, onset timing, body site, diagnostic evidence and stroke-specific classification extensions such as ischemic etiology, hemorrhagic bleeding reason and wake-up stroke status.

Index encounter for an acute stroke episode in the RES-Q registry. It records the patient, completed encounter state, admission and discharge pathway information, hospital locations, first-hospital status, EMS prenotification and post-acute-care applicability.
DiagnosticReport profile for brain, carotid and follow-up imaging reports in the stroke pathway.
Procedure profile for brain imaging performed in the stroke pathway, with optional report linkage and timing context.
Generic MedicationAdministration profile for acute stroke treatment medications, including thrombolysis, anticoagulant reversal, IV antihypertensives and other administrations.
Organization profile for hospitals or registry participants contributing RES-Q stroke data. The profile requires an active organization, a display name and a registry-scoped identifier.
Procedure profile for acute reperfusion interventions, including thrombolysis and mechanical thrombectomy. It supports reason, not-done reason, location, occurrence, complications and timing context.
Condition profile for pre-existing or episode-relevant risk factors captured in the RES-Q registry.
Procedure profile for swallowing screening, including screening type, not-done reason, performer role and timing context.
Generic treatment and rehabilitation profile for ICH, SAH, CVT, craniectomy, therapy, smoking cessation and shunt procedures not given a dedicated meta.profile in the Python builders.
